name: prompt-boundary
note: THE DEFECT, in fixture form. A turn plus the agent it launched run 10:00-10:03, Craig types again at 10:04, and the gap between them is one minute — well inside segment_gap_min, so the gap rule alone glued the two exchanges into one 5-minute 'activity streak' and the residual-life forecast conditioned on an elapsed time that spanned somebody else's turn. The prompt at 10:04 lands while nothing is running, so it is a real human-input boundary and it CUTS: two segments, and the second one starts AT the prompt, which is what makes seg_elapsed mean 'Claude-active time since Craig last spoke'. The second exchange launches a2, still running at `now`, so this session is BUSY and a forecast is issued against the post-prompt segment — a live agent has no ended_at and therefore contributes no interval, which is why the expected rows below do not mention it.
